description: Use this when the user asks what has been found about a relation: does an intervention extend lifespan and in which organisms, what lowers a biomarker. Findings extracted from papers as subject, relation and object (rapamycin extends_lifespan in Mus musculus), with organism, effect size and the paper, newest first. Check one that matters with get_paper. Not for personal medical advice.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

object.description: Object text, entity name or entity key (case-insensitive substring).

organism.description: Organism, e.g. Homo sapiens, Mus musculus (case-insensitive substring).

relation.description: Exact relation, e.g. increases, decreases, associated_with, extends_lifespan.

subject.description: Subject text, entity name or entity key (case-insensitive substring).

name: list_claims
